notes.title: Demo Update: Codex & Options Tweaks
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We’ve got an update for the demo today: 

New Options: 

Added option for audio description mode

Added option for codex entry unlock notifications 

UI Improvements: 

Updated codex UI 

The codex can now be opened during gameplay (so you can read while you read)

Added new section for character close-ups in the CG gallery 

Keyboard navigation

Misc: 

Updated some CGs/closeups

Fixed some typos 



🎺 👻 Haunted Trumpet

notes.title: Demo Release Date: July 31st
notes.notes:
Hello! After a lot of hard work, our demo is finally ready and will be available on July 31st! It includes the complete first episode of The Left Eye, so you can dip your toe into the pansy scene and see if it's your sort of thing! And if it is, why not wishlist the game to stay notified of upcoming episodes?

We're unbelievably excited to start sharing our visual novel with you, and we're grateful to everyone who's shown interest so far. 

See you in New York!



🎺 👻 Haunted Trumpet
